answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing escrowed tasks that independent peers verify, with rewards released after a challenge window. A new identity starts with no reputation, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply its weight; each account must separately fund stakes and build a record. A copper shipment routed through a meadow could illustrate a task, but fabricated deliveries risk forfeited deposits. The attacker pays capital and time for every identity, and one exposed lie can drive its reputation to nadir.
